definitions.explanation: Money borrowed that must be repaid, typically with interest. Used for various purposes including housing, cars, education, and personal expenses.

examples.japanese: {住宅|じゅうたく}ローンを{組|く}んだ。
examples.english: I took out a home loan.

examples.japanese: ローンの{返済|へんさい}が{残|のこ}っている。
examples.english: I still have loan payments remaining.

examples.japanese: {35年|さんじゅうごねん}ローンで{家|いえ}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a house with a 35-year loan.

notes:
ORIGIN:
From English "loan."

COMMON TYPES:
・{住宅|じゅうたく}ローン (home loan/mortgage)
・マイカーローン/{自動車|じどうしゃ}ローン (car loan)
・{教育|きょういく}ローン (education loan)
・カードローン (card loan/personal loan)
・{奨学金|しょうがくきん} (student loan - technically a loan)
・フリーローン (unsecured personal loan)

KEY TERMS:
・{金利|きんり} (interest rate)
・{頭金|あたまきん} (down payment)
・{返済|へんさい}{期間|きかん} (repayment period)
・{月々|つきづき}の{返済額|へんさいがく} (monthly payment)
・{固定|こてい}{金利|きんり} (fixed interest rate)
・{変動|へんどう}{金利|きんり} (variable interest rate)

JAPANESE HOUSING LOANS:
{住宅|じゅうたく}ローン in Japan typically:
・Can extend up to 35 years
・Often have low interest rates
・May qualify for tax deductions ({住宅|じゅうたく}ローン{控除|こうじょ})

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・ローンを{組|く}む (to take out a loan)
・ローンを{返|かえ}す/{返済|へんさい}する (to repay a loan)
・ローンを{完済|かんさい}する (to pay off a loan completely)
・ローンが{通|とお}る (loan is approved)
・ローン{審査|しんさ} (loan review/approval process)
